visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Method Loses Its Object
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Calling the extracted greet function should print Hi, I am Asha, but it prints Hi, I am undefined.

solution.explanation: this is decided by how a function is called, not where it was written. Calling greet() on its own gives it no object, so this.name is undefined. bind(person) fixes this to person permanently.
